messages:
ana: Quick follow-up from todays infra segment  please drop short Qs about regions, autoscale, and customer comms here.

simon: TL;DR: US/EMEA H100s first, APAC mixed A100/H100. Initial APAC racks target late-June. Dedicated reserved capacity first, hosted opens after autoscale validation.

lucy: Will hosted customers notice price changes because of new hardware / batching improvements?

simon: No immediate list-price change. Customers should see lower effective cost-per-request due to batching, KV caching, and model quant profiles. Console cost estimates will reflect this post-rollout.

mike: If a region is saturated, what's the exact fallback order? Need to document for support.

simon: Fallback order: in-region compatible variant -> orgs Dedicated spare capacity (if permitted) -> nearest region cross-route -> queued async for low-priority jobs. We will not silently fail realtime requests to CPU.

harini: Can customers disable cross-region routing? Some enterprise contracts require geo-fencing.

simon: Yes  Dedicated and Private can opt-out via deployment policy; hosted will get a per-org toggle during beta.

ana: (typo)

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: autoscale-policy-v1 applied to staging at 2026-05-12T14:07Z :white_check_mark:

lucy: Sample autoscale snippet for docs (numbers illustrative):

```yaml
autoscale:
  min: 1
  max: 40
  metric: rps_per_gpu
  target: 1000
```

simon: We'll publish tuned thresholds per model class next week and a migration checklist for teams that want to lock region pinning vs use fallback.

harini: Action items: I'll draft customer FAQ + support one-liner about expected latency delta when cross-region occurs. Simon to post rollout windows.

simon: On it  posting ETA table and public FAQ by EOD Thursday. Close thread once docs are pinned.
